newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds ease, room for further losses seen.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds ease, room for further losses seen.

text.p: Austrian bonds edged lower on Tuesday in the wake of losses on the German side, traders said although the German Bund future clawed back some ground towards the end of the session.
Traders saw potential for further declines after the Bundesbank decided to leave monetary policy on hold by keeping the securities repurchase rate fixed at three percent.
* 10-year benchmark 5.625 pct bond maturing July 2007 down 30 bps at 99.40 to yield 5.70 (5.66) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 98.84/94 to yield 5.78/77 pct.
* Five-year 4.625 bond maturing May 2002 down 20 bps at 99.05 to yield 4.85 (4.80) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 98.78/86 to yield 4.91/89 percent.
* Austrian bond future down 43 bps at 108.87.
* 10-year spread over Germany steady at seven bps, five-year up nine bps at 29.
* Money market rates three-month VIBOR steady at 3.438 and overnight money at 3.13/3.38. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
